name: Kepler-78
description: Star of 5,058 K, 124 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

quotes.title: Kepler-78
quotes.card: Kepler-78 is a 12th magnitude star 407 light-years away in the constellation Cygnus.
quotes.introduction: Initially classified as an eclipsing binary with orbital period 0.710015 days, it was later re-classified as a single star with significant interaction between star magnetosphere and close-in planet.
